name: Missing Superposition Event Handler
hint: A superposition operation creates the superposed state and default visual representation even without a handler, but no custom behavior runs for the superposition-start event.
instruction: Add a non-empty [when superposition started] handler to the affected actor to define custom behavior for the superposed state.
